newsitem.title: GERMANY: Every third west German metals firm in the red.
newsitem.headline: Every third west German metals firm in the red.

text.p: Every third west German firm in the metals and electrical sectors is losing money, according to a survey of 900 companies commissioned by the Gesamtmetall employers federation published on Monday.
The survey also showed that the companies, which together employ around 1.5 million workers, earned an average return on sales of just 1.4 percent, down from 1.6 percent last year.
And 57 percent of companies said their earnings situation was poor, while 38 percent said it was satisfactory, and only five percent good.
The survey provides a sufficient basis for companies and union leaders to make use of contractual clauses to limit wage rises in return for jobs guarantees, Gesamtmetall said.
Gesamtmetall is due to begin talks on the national 1997 wage round with the IG Metall trade union in January.
